description: This file defines a Java class 'CreateDelinquencyActionCommandHandler' that handles commands to create delinquency actions within the Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface, processes incoming JSON commands, and delegates the creation logic to 'DelinquencyWritePlatformService'. The class is annotated for dependency injection, transaction management, and command type specification.

classes.name: CreateDelinquencyActionCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler class responsible for processing delinquency action creation commands within the Fineract system.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to create a delinquency action, delegating the task to the 'writePlatformService' and executing within a transaction.
